en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Mihran, raising it, and Ahmad Bin Idrees, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar Al Shaybani who said, ‘Al Qasim Bin Muhammad Al Razy narrated to me saying, ‘Ali Bin Muhammad Al Hurmuzani narrated to us, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When (Syeda) Fatima<sup>asws</sup> passed away, Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> buried her<sup>asws</sup> secretly, and effaced upon the place of her<sup>asws</sup> grave.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> stood and turned his<sup>asws</sup> face towards the grave of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The greetings be upon you<sup>saww</sup>, O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> from me<sup>asws</sup> and the greetings be upon you<sup>saww</sup> from your<sup>saww</sup> daughter<sup>asws</sup>, and she<sup>asws</sup> would be visiting you<sup>saww</sup> and spending the night in the soil in your<sup>saww</sup> spot, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Chose for her<sup>asws</sup> a quick meeting with you<sup>saww</sup>.

Little is my<sup>asws</sup> patience from losing you<sup>saww</sup> and excuse my<sup>asws</sup> tolerance from (losing) the chief-tess of the women of the worlds, except that for me<sup>asws</sup> is the solace with your<sup>saww</sup> Sunnah during your<sup>saww</sup> separation in place of condolence. So I<sup>asws</sup> had placed your<sup>saww</sup> pillow in the chasm of your<sup>saww</sup> grave, and your<sup>saww</sup> soul left between my<sup>asws</sup> throat and my<sup>asws</sup> chest.
Yes, and in the Book of Allahazwj, there is for measws the best of the acceptances [2:156] Surely we are for Allah and to Him we are returning.

I<sup>asws</sup> have returned the deposit and taken the pledge, and the blossom (Al-Zahra<sup>asws</sup>) is no more. So how ugly is the greenery and the dust, O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! As for my<sup>asws</sup> grief, so it is perpetual, and as for my<sup>asws</sup> night, so it is sleepless, and the worries do not come out from my<sup>asws</sup> heart, unless Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Chooses for me<sup>asws</sup> your<sup>saww</sup> dwelling which you<sup>saww</sup> are staying in. 
I<sup>asws</sup> am heartsicken, sorrowful, anxious, upset.

How quick was the separation between us<sup>asws</sup>. And to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> I<sup>asws</sup> complain, and your<sup>saww</sup> daughter<sup>asws</sup> will be informing you<sup>saww</sup> of the concerted efforts of your<sup>saww</sup> community upon devouring her<sup>asws</sup>. So as her<sup>asws</sup>, you<sup>saww</sup> will come to know of the state. So how many were her<sup>asws</sup> sorrows grabbing her<sup>asws</sup> chest, she<sup>asws</sup> could not find a way to expressing them, and she<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘And Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will Judge, and He<sup>azwj</sup> is the best of the judges’.

Greetings of farewell is not what Iasws say, nor out of weariness. So, if Iasws leave, it would not be from disappointment, and if Iasws stay it would not be from pessimism with what Allahazwj Promised the patient ones. Alas! And the patience is more fruitful and more beautiful, and were it not for the pre-dominance of the mischievous ones, Iasws would have made the place and the remaining (here) to be unambiguous and wailed the wailing of the bereaved mother upon the calamity of the child. So in the Sight of Allahazwj, yoursaww daughter is buried secretly, and herasws rights have been devoured, and herasws inheritance prevented, and the covenant is not distance and yoursaww memories are still fresh; and to Allahazwj, O Rasool-Allahsaww, is the complaint, and regarding yousaww, O Rasool-Allahsaww is the best of the condolences. May Allahazwj Send Salawat upon yousaww and upon herasws, the peace and the (Divine) Pleasure’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad in Yahya has narrated from al-‘Amrakiy ibn Ali from Ali ibn Ja‘far from his brother from abu al-Hassan (a.s.) who has said the following. “Fatima is truthful and a martyr. The daughter of the prophet do not experience menses.”
